g.text: Verify Cs, startup margin and drive level on PCB; tune capacitors. Internal Rf=400k.

g.desc: Verify Cs, startup margin and drive level on PCB; tune capacitors. Internal Rf=400k.

g.text: AGND: R3 to GND; MCU_VDDA: R203 to VCC.

g.desc: AGND: R3 to GND; MCU_VDDA: R203 to VCC.

g.text: MCU_VDDA = VCC through R203 (0R), bypass C206/C207 + C208/C213 to AGND.

g.desc: MCU_VDDA = VCC through R203 (0R), bypass C206/C207 + C208/C213 to AGND.

g.text: AVCC LDO remains for external analog amplifiers only.

g.desc: AVCC LDO remains for external analog amplifiers only.

g.text: FAULT pullups: external open-drain HEALTH holds LOW while healthy.

g.desc: FAULT pullups: external open-drain HEALTH holds LOW while healthy.

g.text: Timer break polarity HIGH; unplugged defaults to brake.

g.desc: Timer break polarity HIGH; unplugged defaults to brake.

g.text: Current limits and external fault source remain to be designed.

g.desc: Current limits and external fault source remain to be designed.

g.text: Buttons PD2/PD3/PD4 active-low. See Interface page.

g.desc: Buttons PD2/PD3/PD4 active-low. See Interface page.

g.text: Place each pair at its pin, return to AGND.

g.desc: Place each pair at its pin, return to AGND.

g.text: OLED1.29: I2C0 PB6 AF1 SCL / PB7 AF1 SDA.

g.desc: OLED1.29: I2C0 PB6 AF1 SCL / PB7 AF1 SDA.

g.text: M1 TIMER0: PA8/9/10 AF1; PB13/14 AF2, PB15 AF1.

g.text: M2 TIMER7: PC6/7 AF3, PC8 AF2; PC0/1/2 AF0.

g.desc: M2 TIMER7: PC6/7 AF3, PC8 AF2; PC0/1/2 AF0.

g.text: M1 currents PA0/1/2; M2 currents PA3/4/5 (ADC0/ADC1).

g.desc: M1 currents PA0/1/2; M2 currents PA3/4/5 (ADC0/ADC1).

g.text: IBUS: PC3 / PC5; VBUS PC4; NTC PE7 / PE8 (ADC2).

g.desc: IBUS: PC3 / PC5; VBUS PC4; NTC PE7 / PE8 (ADC2).

g.desc: J200 external probe: never use simultaneously with onboard probe.
